A middle-aged man in a plaid bathrobe opens a standard black curbside mailbox and a soft cloud of warm, fragrant coffee-roast steam drifts out of it. He closes his eyes and leans his face into the drifting steam, smiling wide, and the steam curls gently toward him instead of blowing away.
